FM-1 as a MIDI output

The emulator below receives MIDI on its DIN jack. The files are played with JZZ.js and sent to the emulator, which is also registered in JZZ as the output FM-1 emulator (JZZ().openMidiOut('FM-1 emulator') from the console or another script on this page). The bank list has the General MIDI bank of the repo and a sine test bank. Copy link gives a link that opens this page with the bank and song chosen and plays it at the first click.

loading...

Link options: ?bank=<bank>&song=<song>&play=1&loop=1. The bank is a name from the bank list (default, sine, ...), the song a name from the MIDI list in lower case with dashes (abba-dancing-queen; a part of the name works too, song=astley). A browser plays sound only after a click on the page, so a link shows one big Play button first.

Emulator: fm1-emu (MIT). Firmware and files: mwedmark/fm1-sf2.
